name: Columcille
text: Columcille is the fused Latin-Irish form of the saint's name. MacKillop prints it as a cross-reference headword. The pointer leads into his main Colum article, where the whole name-family around Columb Cille is gathered. The saint himself is treated at Colum Cille. See Colum Cille.

attributes.attribute: cross-reference headword to the main Colum article
fused form of Latin Columba and Old Irish Cille

okr.objective: Columcille is a cross-reference form of the Colum Cille name.
